Talk to your agent.
Out loud.

Windy Talk is the voice of the Windy ecosystem. Say what you need, hear your Windy agent answer, and cut in whenever you like, the way you would with a person. No typing, no push-to-talk.

macOS and Linux today. Free with a Windy account during early access.

How it works

1

Sign in once

Use your Windy account, the same one for every Windy product. There is no separate Talk login.

2

Just talk

Windy Talk listens while the app is open. It notices when you stop speaking, so there is no button to hold.

3

Hear the answer

Your agent thinks with Windy Mind and answers in a natural voice, usually starting in under a second.

4

Interrupt anytime

Start talking while it speaks and it stops to listen, like a real conversation.

What it does

🎙️

Hands-free conversation

A real back-and-forth by voice: it hears you, thinks, and speaks, then listens again.

✋

Natural interruptions

Talk over it to change your mind mid-answer. It stops speaking and takes the new question.

🧠

Powered by Windy Mind

The thinking runs through Windy Mind, the one door to AI in the Windy family, on your own account.

🔐

One Windy login

The same sign-in as Windy Word, Chat, Mail and the rest.

💬

Honest when it is stuck

If the brain is slow or unreachable it tells you so out loud, instead of leaving you in silence.

🧩

Built to be shared

The same voice engine is being prepared for Windy Chat calls and, later, phone calls with your agent.

Private by design

Plain answers, not fine print.

No audio is stored

Your voice is turned into text as you speak and the audio is discarded. We never keep recordings.

Conversation text expires

The text of your conversations is kept so you can pick up where you left off, and is deleted after 7 days without use.

Deleting your account deletes it

Closing your Windy account locks Talk at once and erases your conversation text when the deletion completes.

Logs hold counts, not words

Our service logs record numbers like how many turns and how long they took, never what you said.

Full details: Windy privacy policy.
